snippet.title: Tammuz: Blood and Sand - 2026 Release Trailer - Steam Next Fest
snippet.description:
The sands are calling. Will you answer, or be buried by them? 

Watch the official 2026 Release Trailer for Tammuz: Blood and Sand, featured now in Steam Next Fest!

Experience the brutal world of Tammuz - a unique blend of Story telling and intricate puzzle-box challenges. Outsmart ancient mechanisms, and survive the trials of the desert in this anciant journey.

🔥 PLAY THE DEMO NOW ON STEAM:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/4164840/Tammuz_Blood__Sand/

Why Wishlist Tammuz?
We are an indie team pouring our hearts into this world, and every single wishlist during Steam Next Fest helps us "beat the algorithm" and reach more players. If you like what you see, hitting that wishlist button would mean the world to us!

Join our Community:
Discord: https://discord.gg/aCfbM3VUbA
